Subject: Week-zero: Bridge Hosts, Access Steps and Join Links for Halcyon Health Kickoff

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for confirming the kickoff window. To make week-zero (the first onboarding day) efficient I’ve put together a short runbook and staffing map. Please see the proposed items below and let me know any gaps by EOD: 

1) Proposed kickoff day/time (please confirm):
   - Tuesday, July 20, 2027 — 10:00–11:30 PT (primary)
   - Optional backup: Wednesday, July 21, 09:00–10:30 PT

2) Mandatory attendees from Halcyon: Customer Sponsor, Technical Lead, SSO/Network contact (if SSO will be enabled during week-zero).

3) Redwood attendees and roles (prelim):
   - Priyom Das — CS lead (meeting facilitator, agenda owner)
   - Ben Carter — Onboarding engineer (bridge host/tech fallback)
   - Jonas Weber — Solutions lead (integration overview)
   - Olga Petrov — Customer success ops (cal invites, runbook)

4) Join links / bridge:
   - Primary bridge (Zoom): https://zoom.us/j/123-456-7890 (passcode: Redwood)
   - Backup MS Teams: https://teams.microsoft.com/l/meetup-join/19%3ameeting_xyz
   - Dial-in backup: +1 415-555-0101 (PIN 987654)

5) Access checklist (attached): weekzero-access-inventory.csv — please confirm SSO user inventory and any service accounts that need allowlisting.

6) Deliverables for week-zero:
   - Account access validated (SSO or service accounts)
   - Model routing and initial config walkthrough
   - Security review items flagged for SOC/SC evidence collection

Small ask: please confirm the Technical Lead who will join (name + email) so we can add them to the calendar and the access inventory.

I’ve attached a small CSV with fields we need (usernames, roles, SSO type) and exported an .ics stub for the host rotation. Olga will send the final calendar once we lock time.

Thanks —
Priyom
